title: Seed taxonomy consolidation — April 2026
summary: Consolidation of the A(DAI) canon into a single seed/ directory. Sources: 59 confirmed practitioner research files (results/), 4 bridge drafts (Waldemar Cordeiro, Lillian Schwartz, Harold Cohen, Prema Murthy), 5 classification lens drafts, 177 artworks from the preview cleanup, plus 45 new practitioner drafts authored from the April 2026 seed taxonomy article 'Digital Art Is the Art of Our Age' (Ben Fry, Golan Levin, Jesse Kanda, plus 42 from the brief).

title: Editorial enrichment pass — A(DAI) Seed Canon v1 (April 22, 2026)
summary: Initial enrichment over the consolidated seed. Authored CLASSIFIED_BY edges to the A(DAI) canonical regime, hand-assigned EMBODIES on key practitioner→concept relations, and seeded EXHIBITED_AT (300), BELONGS_TO (148), CREATED_BY (82), USES_TECHNIQUE (75), and INFLUENCES (4) edges from the taxonomy article. Originally also produced 564 keyword-heuristic EMBODIES that were always editorial scaffolding; those were superseded on April 28 by source-attested EMBODIES from objkt, fxhash, and Wikidata depicts and have been removed. 57 hand-assigned EMBODIES (medium confidence) survive.

title: objkt.com artist tags — April 28, 2026
summary: Hasura GraphQL pass against objkt.com. For each ADAI practitioner with an objkt creator address, fetched artist-set tags across their tokens and inferred 975 EMBODIES + 179 CREATED_BY edges. False matches (e.g. 'beeple fan' → Beeple) pruned via prune_real_source_passes.py. Source-attested replacement for a subset of the 564 heuristic EMBODIES from the editorial scaffolding pass.

title: Wikidata depicts/genre — April 28, 2026 (v3b)
summary: Wikidata SPARQL pass for artworks by ADAI practitioners (P170 = creator). Pulls depicts (P180) and genre (P136), maps to ADAI concept nodes by normalized label. Contributes 82 CREATED_BY, 23 EMBODIES, 8 BELONGS_TO, 4 EXHIBITED_AT. v3b supersedes v3 (label-normalization bug).

title: MoMA digital department — April 28, 2026
summary: Filtered pass over MoMA's public Artworks.csv (CC0) targeting Media & Performance / digital-art works. Joined by artist + title against ADAI practitioners. Confirms ~26 artwork nodes and contributes 27 USES_TECHNIQUE + 26 CREATED_BY edges. Distinct from the broader moma-ingest-2026-04-22 pass via the digital-department filter.

title: fxhash artist-set tags — April 28, 2026
summary: fxhash GraphQL pass for artist-applied tags on generative-art tokens. Each artist-set tag becomes an EMBODIES edge from the artwork to a concept node. Contributes 37 EMBODIES. Source-attested replacement for a subset of the 564 heuristic EMBODIES from the editorial scaffolding pass.

title: Rhizome ArtBase net.art — April 28, 2026
summary: Rhizome ArtBase SPARQL pass for net.art works by ADAI practitioners. Practitioner reconciliation used name-normalized exact equality (NFKD + diacritic-strip + lowercase + alphanumeric-only) — explicitly NOT substring matching, the failure mode that caused the 'Beeple Fan' false-match in the objkt pass. Contributes 49 CREATED_BY edges. 10 already-present canonical works (Form Art, Processing, Alphabet Synthesis Machine, etc.) skipped — cross-source agreement is good provenance signal, not redundancy.

title: Wikidata practitioner canon (Christiane Paul lens) — April 28, 2026
summary: Wikidata SPARQL pass adding 22 canonical digital-art practitioners and 5 missing scenes from Christiane Paul's 'Digital Art' canon (Paik, Kac, Stelarc, the Vasulkas, Davies, Rokeby, Shaw, Ascott, Utterback, Sommerer, Mignonneau, Goldberg, Rubin, Hayles, Galloway, Chun, Paul herself). Contributes 31 BELONGS_TO edges connecting these practitioners to scenes (bio art and artificial life, telematic art, virtual environments, locative and mobile art, software art).

title: MoMA Artworks CSV — April 22, 2026 (initial pass)
summary: First pass over MoMA's public Artworks.csv (CC0). Joined by artist + title against ADAI practitioners; produced 58 CREATED_BY edges. Pre-dates the digital-department refinement (moma-digital-ingest-2026-04-28).

title: Art Blocks Hasura API — artwork drafts (April 2026)
summary: Bulk ingest of Art Blocks core-contract projects (V0/V1/V3) whose artist_name matches an existing seed practitioner. Creates draft artwork nodes so follow-up passes (fetch_artblocks.py, editorial review) have something to attach to.

title: Wikidata named-anchors pass — April 28, 2026
summary: Hand-curated 12-entry pass for canonical figures missing from the seed: 10 practitioners (JODI, Eva & Franco Mattes, VNS Matrix, Rafaël Rozendaal, Shu Lea Cheang, Coco Fusco, Rosa Menkman, Stephanie Dinkins, John Gerrard, Maurice Benayoun) plus 2 theorist-anchor stubs (Kittler, Flusser). Verifies QIDs first, then queries P170 (creator) for artworks and P135/P136 (movement/genre) for practitioner-level scene affiliations. Adds 12 practitioners + 9 artworks + 3 concepts + 27 edges (12 CLASSIFIED_BY, 9 CREATED_BY, 4 EMBODIES, 1 BELONGS_TO via the cyberfeminism alias, 1 EXHIBITED_AT to Queens Museum). All 12 anchors resolved with verified QIDs.

title: fxhash API artwork drafts — April 22, 2026
summary: Initial fxhash GraphQL pass for generative-art project drafts whose author matches an ADAI practitioner. Produced 8 CREATED_BY edges. Pre-dates the artist-set tags pass (fxhash-tags-ingest-2026-04-28) which adds the EMBODIES layer.

title: Theorist edge completion — April 29, 2026
summary: Closed a 5-edge gap from the April 28 Paul-canon pass: Galloway, Hayles, and Chun were added as practitioner nodes but no BELONGS_TO edges were authored. Hand-assigned scene affiliations matching their primary critical lens.

title: Gemini Embedding 2 multimodal pass — May 2026
summary: Multimodal embeddings (Gemini Embedding 2, 768-d, L2-normalised) over the A(DAI) seed. Artworks embedded as fused text+image vectors; practitioners/concepts/scenes as text-only. Derive pass produces STYLE_KIN (practitioner↔practitioner) and VISUALLY_AFFINE (artwork↔artwork) edges, plus SUGGESTS_CREATED_BY proposals routed through the curatorial /review queue.
